summary: Comprehensive architecture and implementation plan for 'Little Learners — Explore, Play & Grow', a college DSA project in Java 21 and Spring Boot paired with a React web frontend. Includes all 9 kid-friendly learning modules, 6 interactive mini-games, an adaptive quiz engine, rewards, creative drawing canvas with undo stack, parent analytics, and a dedicated DSA Lab with interactive visualizers for college viva demonstration.
